requiredPatterns.source: Content writes are limited to `wiki\/\*\*` \*\*plus\*\*\s+creating Lisa's own work items in the\s+configured tracker through `lisa-tracker-write`
Do not edit tracker items, post comments, acknowledge alerts
Evidence must name the attempted scope
If any row is missing, `pending`, `partial`, or `unavailable`
Never mark that source gap absorbed
Only list, get, search, query, or export
Redact secrets, passwords, API keys, tokens
Zero open product questions is not enough
`complete` — the entire inventoried scope was fetched read-only
`partial` — some usable scope was ingested and verified
`unavailable` — no usable content could be ingested
cannot prove a read-only operation.*mark the source\s+`unavailable`
configured approved\s+scanner cannot prove removed.*leave the source `partial` or\s+`unavailable`
danger-zone wiki pages Phase 2 already produced
including\s+source notes, synthesis, citations, the source-status registry
never delete or merge away a failed row
never edits, comments on, transitions, or otherwise mutates any ingested source
never license to edit,\s+comment on, transition, acknowledge, close, or otherwise mutate any \*\*ingested\*\* source item
never omit it to make the\s+run look complete
never pauses to ask a human anything
never written back to,\s+commented on, transitioned, acknowledged, or otherwise mutated
omit\s+or aggregate ordinary person-level user data such as names, email addresses
real headless run must be audited
sensitive PII the policy detects \(SSNs, payment-card numbers
